---
number: 107
title: M2.5 Part 5: An application layer under the menu and the command line
milestone: M2.5
labels:
  - Epic
---

The menu and the command line each wire the same runs (evolve and save in three places, pilot then pick by name in three, benchmark in two), map options to settings separately, and load parts and libraries with their own copies; sessions and settings that are not interface code live in `Cli`, and `superopt`, spec files and result bundles are about to add more commands.
We want an application layer of run services that the menu and the command line both call, a command registry with declared options, and `MainMenu` split by menu.

Its responsibilities are:
* Run services for evolve, compile, evolve-parts, compose, reach, benchmark, verify and export, holding the flows now repeated
* A command registry: each command declares its options once, and usage, parsing, errors and the README table come from it
* The menu split by submenu, each calling the run services

The services should take settings values and return typed results, never print, because the menu, the command line and tests all call them.

Order: run services; command registry; menu.

Done when: each run flow exists once, the menu and command line call it, and adding a command means one class and one registration.

Read first: README "Using the GUI", "Extending"
